ingredients:
2 Large chicken breasts
200g Plain yogurt & spices
1 Can crushed tomatoes
100ml Heavy cream
instructions:
1.    Marinate chicken pieces in yogurt and aromatic spices for thirty minutes.
2.    Sear chicken in a hot skillet until lightly charred on all sides.
3.    Simmer with crushed tomatoes and cream until thick and aromatic.
4.    Serve hot with steamed basmati rice and warm flatbread.
title: World Renowned Dish 87

ingredients:
400g Spaghetti
200g Cured guanciale
4 Fresh egg yolks
100g Pecorino Romano cheese
instructions:
1.    Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil and cook pasta until al dente.
2.    Crisp diced guanciale in a hot skillet until rendered and golden.
3.    Whisk egg yolks and grated Pecorino Romano cheese together in a bowl.
4.    Combine pasta and guanciale off the heat, stirring in the egg mixture to create a silky sauce.
